race.comment: Open race where DARK FAE (6) looks hard to beat. Won her maiden here as favourite two back then led and was run over late here last time. This looks easier and expected to take catching despite the draw. TIME POWER (5) raced in the rich Daintree last time at Cairns and wasn't disgraced at huge odds, finishing sixth. This is far easier and drawn to go close. SHE'S A SWEET STAR (9) placed fresh at Bowen then boxed on last time this course and distance. Looks one of the chances. KHALS (2) has a key jockey switch and is worth keeping safe. HEROIC DELANEYS (7) comes through a strong form race last time and can improve sharply.
